entry.hypothesis: Purchase filings that were >= 10% of the insider's post-trade holding (a stake increase of >= 11%) carry more information than small top-ups (PREREG H3).
entry.rationale: The cost of being wrong scales with the trade relative to the insider's own wealth in the firm; holding-relative size, not dollar size, measures conviction.

stopped_names.rule: D07: a holding is sold at the close of its last stored print; no open is fabricated
